summary: JPMDB Commercial Mortgage Securities Trust 2017-C5 filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to record that CWCapital Asset Management LLC was removed and Torchlight Loan Services, LLC was appointed successor special servicer for the Prudential Plaza Mortgage Loan, effective October 14, 2026. That loan represented approximately 6.2% of the issuing entity's asset pool at cut-off and is part of a loan combination serviced under the COMM 2015-CCRE26 PSA. No deal terms, board recommendation, or financial advisors are stated. The filing is a routine servicing-change notice, not a special situation; watch for special servicing actions or loan-level developments.
